youtube.title: Liquid chrome, written as a shader: funkbox's new liquid-metal look in four palettes
youtube.description:
Liquid chrome, written as a shader: funkbox's new liquid-metal look, in chrome, gold, mercury and iridescent.
Each metal is a palette of 12 numbers in recipe.py, and every loop is checked by machine so the last frame flows into the first. No video model; this 21 s Short rendered in under 50 seconds on a 4-core CPU with no GPU.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.
